parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name of the website that is added to Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium for protection.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: The start index, which specifies the position from which the results are displayed. Default value: **0**.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description:
The source of the rule. Valid values:
- **manual** (default): manually added.
- **clover**: automatically generated.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **20**. Default value: **20**.
